messages.text:
Yes, we ship to Brazil, duties paid and priced by value, so nothing extra lands on you at delivery. The B.04 is $249, 6 TH/s, 100 W — about $7 a month at 10¢/kWh.

What are you paying per kWh there?
no extra taxes $249 is going to be $249. right?

Almost — $249 is the unit, and shipping to Brazil is added at checkout, priced by value with duties included. So the total you pay at checkout is it; no customs bill when it lands.

Enter your address at checkout and you'll see the shipping figure before you pay.
